x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change publication-subscriptions-and-daily-digest (REQ-PSD-001, REQ-PSD-002, matrix rows pub-10 and pub-16, tender 408309). PublicationSubscription (slug publication-subscription) holds who follows which bodies and kinds, and how often: a member by Nextcloud account, a resident by portal subject reference. PublicationEvent (slug publication-event) is one published or changed agenda, paper, decision or minutes, which the digest job groups into one message per subscriber.

PublicationSubscription.title: Publication subscription
PublicationSubscription.description: Who follows new and changed agendas, papers, decisions and minutes of which bodies, and how often they hear of them.
PublicationSubscription._authorizationNote: A member reads, changes and removes only their own subscriptions (subscriberUserId is the signed-in account); administrators see all. Create is open to every signed-in member, as on the register row; the digest job only sends to the account that created the subscription, so naming someone else sends nothing. Residents subscribe through the portal (citizen action subscribeToPublications), which stamps subscriberRef from the signed-in subject.

subscriberUserId.title: Member
subscriberUserId.description: The Nextcloud account of the member who subscribes. Empty for a resident.

subscriberRef.title: Resident
subscriberRef.description: The portal subject reference of the resident who subscribes. Empty for a member. decidiq never stores a resident's email address.

governanceBodies.title: Bodies
governanceBodies.description: The bodies to follow. Empty means every body.

kinds.title: What to follow
kinds.description: Agendas, papers, decisions and minutes, one or more.

frequency.title: How often
frequency.description: Immediately (after a short wait that groups an editing session), a daily digest at 07:00, or a weekly digest on Monday at 07:00.

lastSentAt.title: Last sent
lastSentAt.description: When the subscriber last received a message. Set by the digest job.

PublicationEvent.title: Publication event
PublicationEvent.description: One agenda, paper, decision or minutes that was published or changed, as subscribers hear of it.
PublicationEvent._authorizationNote: Administrators read only. Events are written only by decidiq's PublicationEventRecorder, in system context. The write actions are left out on purpose: a schema block replaces the register block whole, so an omitted write stays closed on the object API (RegisterAuthorizationTest, SERVICE_OWNED_WRITES_STAY_CLOSED). A subscriber hears of an event only in a digest, after a read check on its object.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What happened to: an agenda, a paper, a decision or minutes.

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The body the agenda, paper, decision or minutes belongs to.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting it belongs to, when there is one.

objectType.title: Object type
objectType.description: The schema of the object the event is about, such as meeting, agenda-item or decision.

objectId.title: Object
objectId.description: The object the event is about. The digest checks the subscriber may read it before sending.

title.title: Title
title.description: The meeting, paper, decision or minutes title.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One line on what happened, such as: Agenda changed: item 4 added.

isPublished.title: Published
isPublished.description: Whether residents may hear of it: only publicly published agendas, decisions and minutes count.

occurredAt.title: Happened at
occurredAt.description: When it was published or changed.
